prompt: Which tropical rainforest represents a quarter of the total area of remaining tropical forests on Earth and comprises one of the largest and most biodiverse tracts of tropical rainforest in the world?
answer: The **Congo Basin rainforest**—also called the **Congo rainforest**—represents roughly a quarter of Earth’s remaining tropical-forest area and is one of the world’s largest and most biodiverse tropical forest regions.
